reason: Continue attribution and repeat confirmation of relation-content/count-shrink compatibility. Validation macro AUC improves 0.000525 over entry and 0.018173 over DIN. Equal-parameter count-versus-fixed contrasts improve 0.000175–0.000193 across absolute/centered variants; centering adds only 0.000017–0.000035. These single-seed contrasts provisionally favor count dependence, not a centering mechanism or confirmed complementarity. Retain both frozen source bests as replacement controls, distinguish inherited utility from added capacity, and measure training/inference cost. Current best uses 32,964,809 parameters and 31.88s inference versus the standalone count-shrink source at 32,288,965 parameters and 24.29s; it trails newer feedback factorization by 0.001903 AUC while using 31.88s versus 36.95s inference. Repeatable gains over source and capacity controls would support continuation; disappearance under those controls would oppose it. All tasks improve AUC/logloss over DIN; favorite AUC slightly regresses versus entry despite improved logloss, and buy regresses versus count shrink. These trade-offs limit the utility claim.
